versions.startupSource:
1 GOTO1000
40 PI=3.14159
50 INPUT"WEIGHT OF BODY";C
60 INPUT"ANGLE A AND B";S,T
80 S=S/180*PI:T=T/180*PI
90 A=SIN(S):B=SIN(T)
100 D=COS(S):E=COS(T)
110 BB=C/(A+B*D/-E)
120 AA=-D/E*BB
130 PRINT"TENSION ON ROPE A=";BB
140 PRINT"TENSION ON ROPE B=";AA
150 END
